title: Tax Graph Rule
description: A reusable, declarative transformation referenced by edges. The operation enum is generated from the versioned operation registry (registry version 1).

operation.description: v0 primitive set. Bounding is done with MIN/MAX whose operands may be node refs OR literal constants, so CAP/FLOOR/LIMIT were dropped as redundant (an upper bound is MIN(x, const); a lower bound is MAX(x, const); a clamp is MIN(MAX(x, lo), hi)). Rounding is ROUND with parameters {mode: nearest|up|down, increment} - which also covers round-up/down-to-increment, so CEILING and FLOOR-as-rounding were dropped too.

citation_refs.description: Per governance (req. doc Section 13), every supported rule must cite an IRS source.

gate.description: Orthogonal provenance axis: who stood at the promotion gate.
